Lessons: Eve and Sarah: Promise and Waiting; Ruth and Naomi: Loyalty and Redemption; Hannah and Esther: Courage in Prayer and Action; Mary, Mother of Jesus; Mary Magdalene and the Women at the Tomb; Lydia, Priscilla and the Early Church
